name: Robella

skills.name: Ultra Shot
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Light of Bond
skills.description: Selects an ally (excluding self) within a 8 tile radius and applies Unity on it. Only 1 Unity can exist at the same time. After skill usage, Robella gains Extra Command. This skill can only be used once per round

skills.name: Radiant Memory
skills.description: Robella gains Radiant Rise for 2 rounds (Duration decreases at the end of the current round). After skill usage, Robella gains Frost Barrier for 2 turns, Frost Barrier absorbs damage equal to 65% of Robella's initial attack, up to a maximum of 60% of the target's max HP

skills.name: Howling Cyclone
skills.description: Selects 1 direction around self, and deals AoE Freeze damage equal to 120% of attack to all enemy targets in a 4 tile fan-shaped area

skills.name: Critical Insight
skills.description:
At the end of the action, increases Confectance Index by 1 point

After using Frigid Infiltration, consumes all Inspection stacks from the target, and gains an equal number of stacks of Sense Weakness. When the number of stacks of Sense Weakness is more than 2, basic attacks deal Freeze damage instead, and increases CRIT rate by 20%

fortification.effect: Increases ATK by 20% of the selected ally's initial ATK for self

Radiant Rise increases damage dealt by 50% instead

Enhances the effects of Radiant Rise - when using Frigid Infiltration, applies 1 stack of Memory Shock on the target for 2 turns
When the number of stacks of Sense Weakness is more than 5, increases CRIT DMG by 30%, and increases damage dealt by Frigid Infiltration by 30%
Increases damage multiplier to 150% ATK. For each stack of Sense Weakness, increases damage multiplier by 9%
Increases duration of Radiant Rise by 2 rounds (Duration decreases at the end of the current round)
Sense Weakness no longer has a stack limit

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Guard Vent
keys.effect: Before allies with Unity launches an active attack or Interception, applies Defense Down II on the target for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Third-gen Neural Cloud
keys.effect: At the end of the action, if Robella has Radiant Rise, gains Attack Up II for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Extra Attention
keys.effect: Ultra Shot: After skill usage, gains 2 stacks of Sense Weakness

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Less Than A Dinergate
keys.effect: If Robella or allies with Unity deals Freeze damage towards enemies with Shield, increases Shield Pierce Rate by 30% and damage by 20%

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Cool Protection
keys.effect: If Robella is on an allied Frost tile, gains 5 tiles of Additional Movement after using Ultra Shot or Howling Cyclone

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Inner Calm
keys.effect: Before using Frigid Infiltration, dispels 2 buffs from the target

keys.name: Common Key - Justice is My Strenght
keys.effect: ATK +5% / If the holder has Shield, increases Phase damage dealt by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Justice execution calculation
keys.effect:
If posessing Radiant Rise, using basic attack Super Shot grants Extra command. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
When using active skill Radiant Memory or when enemy unit with Inspection is eliminated by an allied unit, gains 3 stacks of Sense Weakness.
Before using an active attack generate Frost tiles within 2 tile radius around self for 2 turns.
